1.plot: 匹兹堡一家医院的急诊室，一集大约是一个小时的班。主治医生罗比带着实习生处理接连进来的病人，私人的事只能插在两副担架之间。
1.plotEn: The emergency room of a hospital in Pittsburgh. An episode is about an hour of a shift. The attending, Robbie, takes the interns through the patients who keep coming in. Private matters can only be fitted between two stretchers.
1.playbill: 一集大致对应急诊室里一小时的班，整季就是一个 15 小时的班次。不靠恋爱戏撑场，靠快速而真实的抢救流程，以及医护人员的疲惫和创伤。《急诊室的故事》里的诺亚·怀尔担任主演，2025 年拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集和男主角。
1.playbillEn: An episode is roughly one hour of a shift in an emergency room, and the season is one fifteen-hour shift. It does not lean on a romance. It leans on a fast, believable sequence of treatment, and on how tired and damaged the staff are. Noah Wyle, from ER, is the lead. In 2025 it won the Emmys for best drama and lead actor.

2.plot: 马特是一位新上任的电影制片公司负责人，为了获得各路名流的认可，他和大陆影业的执行团队必须在公司利益和创意追求之间寻求平衡，同时还要力图为电影制作注入新的生机和活力，并与时俱进。
2.plotEn: Desperate for celebrity approval, the newly appointed head of a movie studio and his executive team at Continental Studios must juggle corporate demands with creative ambitions as they try to keep movies alive and relevant.

3.plot: 1600 年的日本，英国水手布莱克索恩的船漂到岸上，正赶上大名之间决定谁来统治的前夜。翻译真理夫人把两套语言、两套忠诚都扛在身上。
3.plotEn: In Japan in 1600, the English sailor Blackthorne’s ship drifts ashore on the eve of the lords deciding who will rule. Lady Mariko, the translator, carries both languages and both loyalties.
3.playbill: 1600 年的日本，战国末期，一名英国领航员漂流上岸，卷入大名之间的权力斗争。台词大部分是日语，服装、礼仪和政治博弈都很讲究。真田广之主演兼任制片，第一季拿下创纪录的 18 项艾美奖。
3.playbillEn: Japan in 1600, at the end of the warring states. An English navigator washes ashore and is pulled into the struggle among the lords. Most of the dialogue is in Japanese. The costume, the etiquette, and the political maneuvering are all careful. Hiroyuki Sanada stars and produces. The first season won a record 18 Emmys.

4.plot: 拉斯维加斯老牌笑匠黛博拉·万斯事业下滑，被迫和被行业赶走的年轻写手艾娃合作。两个人互相看不起，又都需要对方的句子。
4.plotEn: Deborah Vance, a long-running comic in Las Vegas, is slipping, and is forced to work with Ava, a young writer the industry has pushed out. They look down on each other, and each of them needs the other’s sentences.
4.playbill: 拉斯维加斯的老牌女笑星，和一个被行业封杀的年轻写手合作写段子。两人一开始互相看不上，后来成了最懂彼此的人。珍·斯玛特凭此多次拿下艾美喜剧类女主角，第三季还获得最佳喜剧剧集。
4.playbillEn: An established woman comic in Las Vegas writes material with a young writer the industry has blacklisted. They cannot stand each other at first, and later become the people who understand each other best. Jean Smart has won the Emmy for lead actress in a comedy more than once for it, and the third season also won best comedy series.

5.plot: 媒体巨头洛根·罗伊中风之后，四个子女开始计算谁能接过公司。他们有钱、有伤害，也有一句永远说不出口的话：父亲并不打算交给任何人。
5.plotEn: After the media magnate Logan Roy has a stroke, his four children start calculating who can take the company. They have money and they have injuries, and they have a sentence they can never say: their father does not intend to give it to anyone.
5.playbill: 媒体帝国的父亲和四个子女争继承权，很像现代版《李尔王》。台词刻薄又好笑，几乎每个人都很糟，但都很好看。四季结构完整、结局干脆，三次拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集。
5.playbillEn: A media empire’s father and his four children fight over the succession. It is a lot like a modern King Lear. The dialogue is cruel and funny. Almost everyone is awful, and good to watch. Four seasons, a complete shape, a clean ending. It won the Emmy for best drama three times.

6.plot: 名厨卡米回到芝加哥，接管哥哥自杀后留下的牛肉三明治店。厨房又吵又挤，他想把它做成一家真正的餐厅，家人却还停在丧事里。
6.plotEn: The chef Carmy comes back to Chicago to take over the beef-sandwich shop his brother left when he killed himself. The kitchen is loud and cramped. He wants to make it a real restaurant. The family is still inside the funeral.
6.playbill: 顶级厨师回到芝加哥，接手已故哥哥留下的三明治店。厨房戏非常紧张，镜头和对白像在打仗。第一季第七集一镜到底；第二季的《鱼》是一场全家圣诞晚餐的灾难现场。
6.playbillEn: A top chef comes back to Chicago to take over the sandwich shop his late brother left. The kitchen scenes are extremely tense. The camera and the dialogue feel like a fight. Episode seven of the first season is a single take. “Fishes,” in the second season, is a family Christmas dinner going to pieces.

8.plot: 美国橄榄球教练泰德·拉索被雇去执教一支英国足球队，东家原本指望他搞砸。他用饼干和不肯嘲讽人的办法，先改变了更衣室。
8.plotEn: Ted Lasso, an American football coach, is hired to manage an English soccer team. The owner originally expected him to wreck it. He starts by changing the locker room, with biscuits and a refusal to mock people.
8.playbill: 完全不懂足球的美国橄榄球教练，去执教一支英超球队。他乐观到近乎傻，却慢慢感染了身边的人。第一季是最暖的职场喜剧之一，后面几季单集变长，节奏也变散。
8.playbillEn: An American football coach who knows nothing about soccer is hired to manage a Premier League team. He is optimistic to the point of seeming foolish, and slowly infects the people around him. The first season is one of the warmest workplace comedies. Later seasons make the episodes longer, and the pace looser.

9.plot: 从伊丽莎白二世登基写到世纪之交。王室在这里是一户不能辞职的人家，首相、配偶和子女都要跟职位谈判。三位演员接力扮演女王。
9.plotEn: It follows Elizabeth II from her accession to the turn of the century. The royal family here is a household that cannot resign. Prime ministers, spouses, and children all have to negotiate with the office. Three actors take turns as the queen.
9.playbill: 从伊丽莎白二世登基讲到 21 世纪初，每两季换一批演员，跟着人物一起变老。每集多围绕一个历史事件，比如艾伯凡矿难、戴安娜接受 BBC 采访，适合想了解英国现代史的人。前两季的克莱尔·福伊和马特·史密斯最受好评。
9.playbillEn: From Elizabeth II’s accession into the early twenty-first century. Every two seasons the cast changes, and the characters age with it. Episodes are often built around one historical event, such as the Aberfan disaster or Diana’s interview with the BBC. It suits someone who wants modern British history. Claire Foy and Matt Smith, in the first two seasons, are the most praised.

12.plot: 罗斯一家把财产输光，只好搬进他们曾经当作玩笑买下的小镇。汽车旅馆的两个房间里，原来的做派一点一点碰上来自小镇的善意。
12.plotEn: The Rose family loses its fortune and has to move to the small town they once bought as a joke. In two rooms at the motel, the old manner collides, a little at a time, with the town’s goodwill.
12.playbill: 富豪一家破产，只能搬进他们当玩笑买下的小镇。第一季看着像普通的富人落难喜剧，后面越来越温暖，每个人都有成长。最后一季包揽了艾美喜剧类全部七个主要奖项。
12.playbillEn: A rich family goes broke and has to move to a town they bought as a joke. The first season looks like an ordinary comedy about the rich brought low. Later it gets warmer, and each person changes. The last season swept all seven major comedy Emmys.

13.plot: 维斯特洛的几个家族争夺铁王座，北境的长城外面还有一场被大多数人当成传说的冬天。改编自乔治·R·R·马丁的小说，贵族的联姻和战场用的是同一套规则。
13.plotEn: Several houses in Westeros contest the Iron Throne. Beyond the Wall in the north, a winter that most people treat as legend is also coming. Adapted from the novels of George R. R. Martin, the nobles’ marriages and the battles run on the same set of rules.
13.playbill: 奇幻外壳下是一部权谋剧。主角随时可能死掉，谁都不安全，这是前几季最抓人的地方。制作规模接近电影，《黑水之战》《私生子之战》都是剧集战争场面的标杆。最后一季口碑大跌，前六季仍然值得看。
13.playbillEn: Under the fantasy is a show about power. Lead characters can die at any time, and no one is safe. That is what made the early seasons grip. The scale of the production is close to a film. “Blackwater” and “The Battle of the Bastards” set a standard for war on television. The last season’s reputation collapsed. The first six are still worth watching.

14.plot: 一个在伦敦经营咖啡馆的女人，用对镜头说话来躲开家人、顾客和自己的悲伤。第二季里，她遇到一位同样不该越界的神父。
14.plotEn: A woman running a café in London talks to the camera to get away from her family, her customers, and her own grief. In the second season she meets a priest who is not supposed to cross the line either.
14.playbill: 女主不停对着镜头吐槽，你先被逗笑，后来才发现她在用玩笑躲开悲伤。两季共 12 集，一个下午就能看完。第二季加入安德鲁·斯科特饰演的神父，拿下 2019 年艾美喜剧类最佳剧集、女主角、编剧和导演。
14.playbillEn: The heroine keeps complaining to the camera. You laugh first, and later realize she is using the jokes to stay away from grief. Two seasons, twelve episodes, an afternoon. The second season adds Andrew Scott’s priest. It won the 2019 Emmys for comedy series, lead actress, writing, and directing.

16.plot: 在1958年的纽约，米琪麦瑟尔的生活很美好。她有丈夫和孩子，在他们的上西区公寓享受美好的赎罪日晚餐。但是当她的生活出乎意料地转变方向时，她必须快速决定她还擅长什么。所有人都认为从家庭主妇到脱口秀喜剧演员是疯狂的选择，但她不这么想。
16.plotEn: It’s 1958 Manhattan and Miriam “Midge” Maisel has everything she’s ever wanted - the perfect husband, kids, and Upper West Side apartment. But when her life suddenly takes a turn and Midge must start over, she discovers a previously unknown talent - one that will take her all the way from the comedy clubs of Greenwich Village to a spot on Johnny Carson’s couch.

17.plot: 在生育率崩溃后的基列国，能生育的女性被编为使女，分配给权贵家庭。琼以奥芙弗雷德的名字生活，记住自己原来叫什么成了一种反抗。
17.plotEn: In Gilead, after fertility collapses, women who can bear children are made Handmaids and assigned to the households of the powerful. June lives under the name Offred. Remembering what she used to be called becomes a form of resistance.
17.playbill: 改编自阿特伍德的小说：美国被极权宗教政权取代，有生育能力的女性被分配到高官家里生孩子。第一季压抑而精准，让 Hulu 成为第一个拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集的流媒体平台。后几季越拍越长，评价有所下滑。
17.playbillEn: Adapted from Atwood’s novel. The United States is replaced by a religious authoritarian regime, and women who can have children are assigned to the houses of senior officials to bear them. The first season is oppressive and exact. It made Hulu the first streaming service to win the Emmy for best drama. The later seasons got longer, and the reception slipped.

18.plot: 塞琳娜·迈耶是美国副总统，日程全是没人想要的访问和随时会塌的联盟。她想当总统，幕僚想活命，每一集的危机都来自上一句随口的话。
18.plotEn: Selina Meyer is the vice president of the United States. The schedule is full of visits no one wants and alliances that can collapse at any moment. She wants to be president. The staff want to survive. Each episode’s crisis comes from the previous offhand sentence.
18.playbill: 美国副总统和她的幕僚永远在救火，政治在这里只剩甩锅、抢镜头和骂人。脏话写得极有创意，节奏快到要暂停回看。朱莉娅·路易斯-德雷弗斯凭此连拿六座艾美喜剧类女主角。
18.playbillEn: The vice president and her staff are always putting out fires. Politics here is only passing the blame, grabbing the camera, and swearing. The obscenities are extremely inventive, and the pace is fast enough that you will pause and go back. Julia Louis-Dreyfus won six Emmys for lead actress in a comedy for it.

23.plot: 高中化学老师沃尔特·怀特确诊肺癌，为了给家人留下钱，与前学生杰西合伙制造冰毒。一条房车里的生计，慢慢变成一座他不肯交出的帝国。
23.plotEn: Walter White, a high-school chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with lung cancer. To leave money for his family he partners with his former student Jesse and starts making meth. A living made in a trailer slowly becomes an empire he will not hand over.
23.playbill: 看一个普通人怎样一步步变成毒枭，每次转变都有前因，不是突然黑化。克兰斯顿凭这个角色拿了四座艾美剧情类男主角。前两季稍慢，越往后越紧；第五季的《奥兹曼迪亚斯》常被评为美剧史上最好的单集之一。
23.playbillEn: You watch an ordinary man become a drug lord, and each turn has a cause. He does not simply go bad. Cranston won four Emmys for best actor in a drama for the role. The first two seasons are a little slow, and it tightens after that. “Ozymandias,” in the fifth season, is often called one of the best single episodes in American television.

24.plot: 普里切特一家三支，以假纪录片的方式过同一座城市里的日子：再婚、同志伴侣和传统郊区家庭，麻烦都出在晚饭之前。
24.plotEn: Three branches of the Pritchett family get through their days in the same city, shot as a fake documentary: a second marriage, a same-sex couple, and a conventional suburban family. The trouble all arrives before dinner.
24.playbill: 伪纪录片形式拍三个有亲戚关系的家庭：老夫少妻、同性伴侣和普通的三口之家。每集半小时，笑点稳定，很适合全家一起看。连续五年拿下艾美最佳喜剧剧集。
24.playbillEn: A mockumentary of three related households: an older man with a younger wife, a same-sex couple, and an ordinary family of three. Half an hour an episode, the jokes are steady, and it is easy to watch together. It won the Emmy for best comedy five years in a row.

27.plot: 中情局军官嘉莉·马蒂森认定，被救回来的海军陆战队员布罗迪已经倒向敌人。她的判断力极强，也受躁郁症左右，局里没有人愿意完全相信她。
27.plotEn: The CIA officer Carrie Mathison becomes convinced that Brody, a Marine who has been brought home, has turned. Her judgment is extremely sharp, and it is also steered by bipolar disorder. No one at the agency is willing to believe her completely.
27.playbill: 一名被俘多年的美军士兵归国，中情局女特工嘉莉怀疑他已被策反。第一季把「他到底是不是」的悬念吊得非常好。克莱尔·丹妮丝演的嘉莉既有天才般的判断力，也受双相障碍困扰，是全剧的核心。
27.playbillEn: A Marine comes home after years in captivity, and the CIA officer Carrie suspects he has been turned. The first season holds the question “is he or isn’t he” very well. Claire Danes’s Carrie has a near-genius judgment and is also living with bipolar disorder. She is the center of the show.

29.plot: 1960 年代的麦迪逊大道，创意总监唐·德雷珀替客户发明欲望，自己则靠一个偷来的名字过活。办公室里的性别、酒和晋升，比广告本身更忙。
29.plotEn: On Madison Avenue in the 1960s, the creative director Don Draper invents desires for clients and lives under a name he stole. Gender, drink, and promotion in the office are busier than the advertising.
29.playbill: 1960 年代的纽约广告业，西装、烟酒和办公室政治都拍得极讲究。主线是唐·德雷珀的身份之谜，佩吉从秘书升为文案的那条线同样好看，十年的社会变化都藏在背景里。节奏慢，适合细看；连续四年拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集。
29.playbillEn: New York advertising in the 1960s. The suits, the cigarettes, the drinks, and the office politics are all made with great care. The main line is the mystery of Don Draper’s identity. Peggy’s rise from secretary to copywriter is just as good to watch, and a decade of social change sits in the background. It is slow, and it rewards attention. It won the Emmy for best drama four years running.

34.plot: 利兹·莱蒙负责一档周六晚间喜剧，上司杰克·多纳吉把管理和约会都当成并购。演员、编剧和电视网每周都在把节目从崩溃里拽回来。
34.plotEn: Liz Lemon runs a Saturday-night comedy show. Her boss, Jack Donaghy, treats management and dating as acquisitions. Every week the actors, the writers, and the network drag the show back from collapse.
34.playbill: 蒂娜·菲根据自己当《周六夜现场》首席编剧的经历改编，讲一档喜剧节目的幕后乱象。笑话密度极高，背景里也塞满了梗。亚历克·鲍德温演的电视台高管杰克是全剧最大的亮点。
34.playbillEn: Tina Fey based it on her years as head writer of Saturday Night Live, and it is about the chaos behind a comedy show. The jokes are packed tight, and the background is full of them too. Alec Baldwin’s network executive, Jack, is the best thing in it.

37.plot: 本剧呈现黑手党生活、美国家庭、意裔美国人社群、暴力支配的世界与道德的灰色地带。由詹姆士·甘多费尼（James Gandolfini）、萝兰·布雷柯（Lorraine Bracco）、艾迪·法柯（Edie Falco）及麦克·英普雷欧里（Michael Imperioli）领衔主演。剧情的主线围绕在东尼·沙普蓝诺（甘多费尼饰）的家庭与自己所领导的犯罪组织的各式矛盾与冲突。
37.plotEn: The story of New Jersey-based Italian-American mobster Tony Soprano and the difficulties he faces as he tries to balance the conflicting requirements of his home life and the criminal organization he heads. Those difficulties are often highlighted through his ongoing professional relationship with psychiatrist Jennifer Melfi. The show features Tony's family members and Mafia associates in prominent roles and story arcs, most notably his wife Carmela and his cousin and protégé Christopher Moltisanti.

39.plot: 深夜12点，美国洛杉矶反恐小组负责人杰克·鲍尔（基弗·萨瑟兰 Kiefer Sutherland 饰）接到同事妮娜·麦尔斯（莎拉·克拉克 Sarah Clarke 饰）的电话，让他火速回办公室，因为情报显示。首位黑人总统候选人——参议员大卫·派尔默（丹尼斯·海斯伯特 Dennis Haysbert 饰）正受到暗杀威胁，而且CTU里面可能有内鬼。因此杰克需要在接下来的这24小时内，追踪杀手保护总统候选人，并查出内鬼。同时，杰克的女儿金姆（伊丽莎·库斯伯特 Elisha Cuthbert 饰）偷跑出家与女友珍妮去参加派对，却不想被挟持。为了找到女儿，特瑞（伊丽莎·库斯伯特 Elisha Cuthbert 饰）和珍妮的父亲只得独自去寻找女儿。可是，不想女儿被绑架原来是恐怖分子策划的，寻找女儿的妻子特瑞也一同被恐怖分子所绑架。为了拯救妻女的性命，杰克不得不听从首领格恩斯（迈克尔·马西 Michael Massee 饰）的摆布。在接下来的时间里，杰克只得使尽浑身解数，在保证妻女安全的同时，还得保护总统候选人派尔默的安全……
39.plotEn: Counterterrorism agent Jack Bauer fights the bad guys of the world, a day at a time. With each week's episode unfolding in real-time, "24" covers a single day in the life of Bauer each season.

40.plot: 宾夕法尼亚一家纸业公司的斯克兰顿分公司，经理迈克尔·斯科特把办公室当成自己的舞台。假纪录片拍下销售、恋爱，以及谁都不想参加的派对。
40.plotEn: At the Scranton branch of a paper company in Pennsylvania, the manager Michael Scott treats the office as his stage. A fake documentary records the sales, the romances, and the parties no one wants to attend.
40.playbill: 伪纪录片形式拍一家纸业公司的日常，老板迈克尔每次想当好人都会搞砸。吉姆和帕姆的感情线是很多人坚持看下去的原因。第一季还在模仿英版，从第二季开始找到自己的风格，前七季最好。
40.playbillEn: A mockumentary of daily life at a paper company. Every time the boss, Michael, tries to be a good person, he wrecks it. Jim and Pam’s relationship is the reason a lot of people stay. The first season is still imitating the British original. From the second season it finds its own style. The first seven seasons are the best.

41.plot: 一架客机坠毁在热带岛屿，幸存者很快发现这里不是普通的荒岛。每一集用倒叙打开一个人的过去，岛上的谜则越开越多。
41.plotEn: A passenger plane crashes on a tropical island, and the survivors soon find it is not an ordinary deserted island. Each episode opens someone’s past in flashback. The mysteries on the island keep multiplying.
41.playbill: 飞机坠毁在神秘海岛，幸存者遇到越来越多怪事。每集穿插一个人的过去，人物塑造很扎实，也带起了悬疑美剧层层埋坑的风潮。前几季极其上头，结局争议很大。
41.playbillEn: A plane crashes on a mysterious island, and the survivors meet stranger and stranger things. Each episode cuts in someone’s past. The people are solidly built, and the show started the fashion for mystery series that keep burying clues. The early seasons are extremely addictive. The ending was heavily argued over.

42.plot: 地产商乔治·布卢斯被捕后，儿子迈克尔试图拉住这个不断内斗的家族。旁白补上他们不肯承认的那半句，笑话常常要到后面几集才收回来。
42.plotEn: After the developer George Bluth is arrested, his son Michael tries to hold together a family that keeps turning on itself. The narrator supplies the half of the sentence they will not admit, and the jokes are often paid off several episodes later.
42.playbill: 富豪老爸被捕后，只有二儿子迈克尔想撑住这个家，其他人都在添乱。这是最需要专心看的喜剧之一，伏笔和梗会隔好几集甚至好几季才回收。前三季是经典；Netflix 复活的第四、五季口碑差一些。
42.playbillEn: After the rich father is arrested, only the second son, Michael, tries to keep the family standing. Everyone else makes it worse. It is one of the comedies you have to watch closely: setups come back episodes, or seasons, later. The first three seasons are the classic run. The fourth and fifth, revived by Netflix, were received less well.

44.plot: 凯莉成为了一个成功的作家，身边依然有3名好友萨曼莎、夏洛特、米兰达陪伴身边，她们依然时尚美丽。 这次凯莉还即将要嫁给一生中最爱的男人Mr.Big，他们拥有自己的房子。她怀着激动的心情与好友们分享心情。可是婚礼的筹备让大先生感受到了压力。这时米兰达的婚姻出现了问题，因为米兰达的一句话，使大先生对自己这第三次婚姻更感不安了。果然，大先生拒绝在婚礼当天出现，即使他想回头的时候，已经伤透了凯莉的心。好友们极力安慰凯莉，米兰达也深感内疚。凯莉搬回了自己的公寓，在助手的帮助下开始了新生活。凯莉每天都想念着大先生，当米兰达告诉她自己的内疚之处时，她生气不已。 几个月过去了，夏洛特再次遇到了大先生，他把即将临盘的夏洛特送进医院，同时也期待凯莉的出现……
44.plotEn: Based on the bestselling book by Candace Bushnell, Sex and the City tells the story of four best friends, all single and in their late thirties, as they pursue their careers and talk about their sex lives, all while trying to survive the New York social scene.

45.plot:
大唐皇后武则天（归亚蕾 饰）怀胎12月而无法临盆。大雨连天，当大胜突厥的喜讯传来之时，武则天羊水破了。公主就这样在漫天风雨中来到世界。唐高宗李治认定女儿的降世将为天下带来好运，当场赐名太平公主。

　　少年太平（周迅 饰）顽皮不堪，捉弄三个哥哥，戳破好姐妹韦氏（胡静 饰）与哥哥显的小爱情，却也目睹了宫内斗争的风雨。但这些风雨离太平还很遥远。直到她16岁与韦氏偷偷出宫，在夜市扰攘中偶遇薛绍（赵文瑄 饰），少女情窦初开。

　　在太平的请愿下，武则天明知薛绍早有妻室也答应了太平的请婚，一手安排了薛绍妻子慧娘的赐死，也为太平的婚姻悲剧埋下伏笔。婚后无论太平如何温柔体贴，薛绍始终不置一词。然而倔强为爱不顾一切的太平（陈红 饰）赢得了薛家上下的信任，当真相被无情揭露时，薛家对她的唯一请求是保留薛家的血脉——叶儿。薛绍的死给太平带来了极大的创伤，也为母女关系扯开一道无法弥合的裂缝。

　　武则天登基，创立大周朝。太平为了与母亲赌气而嫁给憨厚老实却一无所长的武攸嗣（傅彪 饰），度过了五年漫长的毫无喜悦的婚姻。但这段时期却培养了太平的政治能力，她一而再再而三地为母亲解决了政治危机，深得武则天器重。然而她仍然拒绝入主政治。深爱太平却苦于无法得到太平的心的武攸嗣一次酒后偷欢，被太平撞见后羞愧自尽。太平就这样结束了自己的第二段婚姻。

　　当与薛绍长相酷似的张易之（赵文瑄 饰）出现在太平面前时，太平的心再次被捕。然而在交往中，她明白张易之绝对不是薛绍，他们只有情欲的纠缠，而张易之是渴望通过掌控女人来掌控天下。张易之不仅与太平有染，还与韦氏和武则天有关系，这深深地伤害了太平的心。当张易之企图篡位时，远道赶来的太平一刀结束了他的生命，斩断了自己的爱情。

　　武则天去世，太平成了镇国公主。侄子李隆基对她呵护有加，当年的叶儿也长成了高大的好青年，并与李隆基是挚交好友。这两位年轻人用自己的方式爱着太平：李隆基是要让姑母得到天下权利而爱她，叶儿则是让太平离开权利纷争而爱她。这矛盾一触即发……
45.plotEn: Palace of Desire, also known as Da Ming Gong Ci, is a Chinese television series based on the life story of Princess Taiping, a daughter of China's only female emperor Wu Zetian. Directed by Li Shaohong and Zeng Nianping, the series starred Chen Hong, Zhou Xun, Gui Yalei and Winston Chao in the leading roles. It was first broadcast on CCTV-8 in mainland China on March 30, 2000.

46.plot:
30岁的过气女模特叶山南（山口智子饰）在婚礼当天惨遭无良未婚夫卷款逃婚。当她怒不可遏的狂奔到未婚夫居所，只堵截到了无辜的室友濑名秀俊（木村拓哉饰）——一个不得志的24岁钢琴家。身无分文又无家可归的小南对濑名威逼利诱，成为了他的新同居人。两人在同一屋檐下的生活磕磕绊绊 ，事业爱情也都不甚顺畅，渐渐竟生惺惺相惜之感。小南的弟弟叶山真二（竹野内丰饰）带着女友突然造访，与濑名暗恋的学妹奥泽凉子（松隆子饰）暗生情愫，使得众人关系更为微妙。濑名在小南与凉子间徘徊，令追求小南的摄影师杉崎得以强势介入，两人的感情面临岌岌可危的局面……在这个神赐的悠长假期里，他们是否都能听从内心真实的选择，找到最适合的归宿？

本剧曾一举包揽第九回日剧学院赏最优秀作品赏、主演男/女优赏、助演男/女优赏、脚本赏等10项大奖。
46.plotEn: Minami who is dumped by her ex-boyfriend, Asakura, on their wedding day. She later meets Sena, Asakura's ex-roommate and a pianist, and lives with him as she has no other place to stay. What will happen to her during this long vacation?

48.plot: 六位好友生活在纽约，共同经历爱情、事业、家庭与友情中的种种变化，在相互陪伴中度过人生的重要阶段。
48.plotEn: Six young people from New York City, on their own and struggling to survive in the real world, find the companionship, comfort and support they get from each other to be the perfect antidote to the pressures of life.

50.plot: Will Truman从哥伦比亚大学和纽约大学的法律专业毕业后，在一个一流的法律公司工作，目标是当上公司的合伙人。但后来辞职，决定开展自己的事业。Will最好的朋友Grace Adler拥有自己的室内装饰公司。两人在大学里认识的。经过短暂的交往后，Will意识到自己真正的性取向，两人和平分手，促成了一段美好的a gay- straight friendship。他们之间不用言语的沟通就可以明白对方心里所想，互相支持，互相理解，拥有最牢固的友情。
50.plotEn: Will Truman and Grace Adler are best friends living in New York, and when Grace's engagement falls apart, she moves in with Will. Together, along with their friends, they go through the trials of dating, sex, relationships and their careers, butting heads at times but ultimately supporting one another while exchanging plenty of witty banter along the way.

52.plot: 这是美国历史上最伟大的喜剧之一。这一切都来自一位名叫弗莱泽的波士顿的精神病医生，在结束了自己两段不幸福的婚姻后，心灰薏冷的返回了自己父亲的老家西雅图，父亲从英国请来的私人女健康顾问以及同为精神病医生的弟弟共同住进了一所公寓，弗莱泽医生在当地的广播电台找到了工作，充当一个类似心理咨询栏目的主播，在这个岗位上，他可以借着电波为人们解决心理上的难题，也因此结识了很多朋友，也被迫天天面对着“热情”的女节目制作人。同时，作为喜剧，弗莱泽的后院也不会安然无恙。他的警察父亲倒不是最麻烦的，麻烦的是他弟弟深深暗恋着女健康顾问，经过弗莱泽和弟弟六年的努力，二人终于开始交往，种种复杂的情况带来了无穷的笑料。
52.plotEn: After many years spent at the “Cheers” bar, Frasier moves back home to Seattle to work as a radio psychiatrist after his policeman father gets shot in the hip on duty.

57.plot: 本片融警匪与法庭于一体的电视剧，片中讲述的犯罪基本原于真实生活，往往是近期报纸上的头条新闻。节目分为两部分，上半部分介绍警察研究现场，征询证人，提审嫌疑犯等一系列的侦破活动，后半部分详尽记录了案件侦破的后期工作，案件转交到检查官手里，检查官衡量案情，起诉，直到庭审，节奏紧凑，扣人心弦。由于最终坏人不一定被绳之于法，所以观众看的时候往往暗自捏一把汗。
57.plotEn: In cases ripped from the headlines, police investigate serious and often deadly crimes, weighing the evidence and questioning the suspects until someone is taken into custody. The district attorney's office then builds a case to convict the perpetrator by proving the person guilty beyond a reasonable doubt. Working together, these expert teams navigate all sides of the complex criminal justice system to make New York a safer place.

59.plot: 美国 FBI 探员福克斯·穆德（大卫·杜楚尼 David Duchovny 饰）童年时曾经历一起离奇神秘的绑架案，他的妹妹萨曼莎在睡梦中被外星人劫持，至今下落不明。从此穆德便专注于神秘事件的研究，并专门负责FBI总部的X档案部门。因穆德行事乖张，难以驾驭。FBI 高层从联邦调查局学院调来女性探员黛娜·斯科莉（吉莲·安德森 Gillian Anderson 饰），表面上是协助穆德工作，实际上是希望这名崇尚科学的理性探员能够制约穆德的行为。两人最初的合作并不理想，完全不同的思维模式时刻导致争论的爆发。但随着各种离奇案件的出现以及两人交往的加深，穆德和斯科莉最终变成可以为对方出生入死的可靠伙伴……
59.plotEn: The exploits of FBI Special Agents Fox Mulder and Dana Scully who investigate X-Files: marginalized, unsolved cases involving paranormal phenomena. Mulder believes in the existence of aliens and the paranormal while Scully, a skeptic, is assigned to make scientific analyses of Mulder's discoveries that debunk Mulder's work and thus return him to mainstream cases.

61.plot: 本系列是美国制作的一部犯罪题材的电视剧，主要讲述了曼哈顿第15分局警探的破案经历。本剧在讲述真实的犯罪和警方侦破细节的同时，也深入刻画了警察的平凡生活，描述了办案期间的矛盾心态及警察的生活烦恼。
61.plotEn: Police drama set in New York City, exploring the internal and external struggles of the fictional 15th precinct of Manhattan. Each episode typically intertwined several plots involving an ensemble cast.

63.plot: 《警戒围栏》讲述了一个小镇的生活——在这个案例中是威斯康星州的罗马小镇；它围绕着布洛克一家展开。吉米·布洛克是小镇的警长，喜欢认为自己就是关注的中心。他的妻子吉尔是小镇的医生；他们有三个孩子：金伯利，18岁，马修，13岁和扎卡里，10岁。在这个小镇里发生了很多事情，从奇怪的谋杀到强奸、袭击、酒驾、绑架和自燃。似乎美国发生的所有犯罪案件都曾在某个时候发生在罗马，他们必须以自己独特的方式去处理这些事情。
63.plotEn: An aging Sheriff tries to keep the peace in Rome, Wisconsin, a small town plagued by bizarre and violent crimes.

66.plot: 没有主题，没有主线，却造就了一部里程碑般的情景喜剧。喜剧演员杰里和他的三位尖刻而幽默的朋友就这样在无聊与荒谬里不断发现乐趣。
66.plotEn: A stand-up comedian and his three offbeat friends weather the pitfalls and payoffs of life in New York City in the '90s. It's a show about nothing.

67.plot: 一位刚从哥伦比亚大学医学院毕业的学生，在获得州政府提供的奖学金后，被要求前往阿拉斯加一个民风奇特的小镇开设诊所。
67.plotEn: After receiving a scholarship from the state, a recent Columbia University medical school graduate is required to set up his practice in an eccentric Alaskan town.

68.plot: 墨菲·布朗 (Murphy Brown) 是一位正在康复中的酒鬼，在贝蒂·福特诊所 (Betty Ford Clinic) 住院治疗中心住过一段时间后，他首次重返虚构的新闻杂志《仅供参考》。 Over 40 and single, she is sharp tongued and hard as nails. In her profession, she is considered one of the boys, having shattered many glass ceilings encountered during her career.她在《仅供参考》新闻杂志上占据主导地位，被描绘成美国最有影响力的媒体人物之一（尽管不是最热情或更富有同情心的）。
68.plotEn: Murphy Brown is a recovering alcoholic who returns to the fictional newsmagazine FYI for the first time following a stay at the Betty Ford Clinic residential treatment center. Over 40 and single, she is sharp tongued and hard as nails. In her profession, she is considered one of the boys, having shattered many glass ceilings encountered during her career. Dominating the FYI news magazine, she is portrayed as one of America's hardest-hitting (though not the warmest or more sympathetic) media personalities.

69.plot: 《三十多岁》是一部关于一群三十多岁的婴儿潮一代的美国电视剧。
69.plotEn: thirtysomething is an American television drama about a group of baby boomers in their late thirties.

70.plot:
历时10年多的电视连续剧，足以影响一代人。这个作品就是其中之一，也许很少中国人知道，现在在英国的C4电视台仍然播出着，其魅力是历经时间的长河。

　　一个普通的波士顿小酒吧，来这里的每个人都互相认识，出了酒吧各自有着喜怒哀乐的故事，进了酒吧就是嬉笑怒骂的“一家人”。Woody据说就是从此出名，其后才参演多部著名作品，比如Naturally born kill(天生杀人狂)等，非常多产。
70.plotEn: The story about a blue-collar Boston bar run by former sports star Sam Malone and the quirky and wonderful people who worked and drank there.

71.plot: 讲诉洛杉矶一家大型律师事务所员工的生活和工作。
71.plotEn: The high-powered law firm of McKenzie, Brackman, Chaney and Kuzak handles both criminal and civil cases, usually for high fees. However, office politics and romance often distract the legal staffers from matters in the courtroom.

74.plot:
《纯真年代》是美国上世纪80年代家喻户晓的经典剧集并同时荣获当年艾美奖最佳导演和剧本和金球奖最佳剧集，

　　该片的故事背景设在美国上世纪60年代，讲述一个叫KEVIN的男孩对其个人成长的回忆，从童年一直到青少年，

　　他会体验每个男孩所都会有的成长经历，比如他的初恋，他的朋友，他对家人的理解，和他对社会的理解，

　　可以说该剧不仅是一个小男孩的成长史，也是对于美国60年代种种文化现象的反映，比如嬉皮士，毒品，性解放，

　　摇滚乐，反战，越战，女权等，该剧通过一个小男孩的视角去理解和展现这些文化现象，有趣又不失批判性，

　　当然该剧主要还是以小男孩的成长经历为故事结构，如果你喜欢《人人都恨克里斯》黑人小孩的成长喜剧，

　　那么这部白人小孩成长温情剧也不会让你失望。
74.plotEn: The story of Kevin Arnold facing the trials and tribulations of youth while growing up during the 1960s and 70s. Told through narration from an adult Kevin, Kevin faces the difficulties of maintaining relationships and friendships on his enthralling journey into adulthood.

76.plot: 几位已到古稀之龄的女士，一起住在一个屋子里面的故事。可想而知，这几位老太太闹出了各种各样的笑话，引出了让人捧腹的嬉笑场面。故事里的几位主角年纪虽加起来已经有好几百岁了，但这些老太太仍然活力充沛，唱歌跳舞样样精通，还不时约会一下年纪相仿的男士。
76.plotEn: Four Southern Florida seniors share a house, their dreams, and a whole lot of cheesecake. Bright, promiscuous, clueless and hilarious, these lovely, mismatched ladies form the perfect circle of friends.

79.plot: 因妻子外遇而离婚的黑板五郎，带着一对儿女从东京来到充满田园风光的北海道富良野生活。影片细腻地描写他们在北方富良野的田园生活和爱情，以及从学校走入社会工作，成家立业，生儿育女。剧中人物尽管有各种不如意的生活经历和自己无法掌控的现实，但他们最终都能战胜所面临的逆境，更加理解身边的人和事。
79.plotEn: Narrated by the son, Jun, the tale follows the lives of two children torn between their parents and their parents' divorce. Jun, and his sister Hotaru, grow and mature - willingly and sometimes forcibly - in the harsh climates of Hokkaido, learning the ways of life through their interaction with the folk of Furano.

80.plot: 《科斯比秀》是一部由比尔·科斯比主演的美国电视情景喜剧，从 1984 年 9 月 20 日到 1992 年 4 月 30 日在 NBC 播出了八季。该剧主要讲述了居住在纽约布鲁克林的中上阶层非裔美国家庭赫克斯塔布尔 (Huxtable) 家族的故事。
80.plotEn: The Cosby Show is an American television situation comedy starring Bill Cosby, which aired for eight seasons on NBC from September 20, 1984 until April 30, 1992. The show focuses on the Huxtable family, an upper middle-class African-American family living in Brooklyn, New York.

83.plot: 真实地了解城市警察局警官和侦探的日常生活。
83.plotEn: A realistic glimpse into the daily lives of the officers and detectives at an urban police station.

88.plot: 巴尼·米勒是我们都想遇到的那种警察。他总是很明智，维持着一群侦探的秩序，这些侦探赌博、撞到裙子上的任何东西、参加文艺复兴哲学大会取乐，并且真的更喜欢写作。几乎所有的行动都发生在班室内，公民和罪犯都被带进来，使情况变得更加复杂。
88.plotEn: Barney Miller is the kind of cop we'd all like to run into. Always sensible, he maintains order over a band of detectives who gamble, hit on anything in skirts, go to renaissance philosophy conventions for fun, and would really prefer to be writing. Nearly all of the action takes place in the squad room where citizens and criminals are brought in to complicate the mix.

90.plot: 路易·德·帕尔马 (Louie De Palma) 是纽约市一名脾气暴躁、尖酸刻薄的出租车调度员。他试图维持为他开车的一群形形色色、奇怪的人物的秩序。当他在安全的“笼子”里欺负和侮辱他们时，他们之间形成了一种特殊的联系，成为朋友并互相支持，度过生活中不可避免的考验和磨难。
90.plotEn: Louie De Palma is a cantankerous, acerbic taxi dispatcher in New York City. He tries to maintain order over a collection of varied and strange characters who drive for him. As he bullies and insults them from the safety of his “cage,” they form a special bond among themselves, becoming friends and supporting each other through the inevitable trials and tribulations of life.

91.plot: 一名前电视台经理转为报纸城市编辑及其记者人员的审判。
91.plotEn: The trials of a former television station manager turned newspaper city editor, and his journalist staff.

95.plot: 脾气暴躁但讨人喜欢的洛杉矶 PI 吉姆·罗克福德 (Jim Rockford) 毫不留情（但也下了不少功夫）。罗克福德是一名前科犯，因犯下的罪行而被送进监狱，他在强硬的老人、律师女友和一些过去的阴暗同伙的帮助下，接手了别人不想接手的案件。
95.plotEn: Cranky but likable L.A. PI Jim Rockford pulls no punches (but takes plenty of them). An ex-con sent to the slammer for a crime he didn't commit, Rockford takes on cases others don't want, aided by his tough old man, his lawyer girlfriend and some shady associates from his past.

96.plot: 阿奇·邦克（Archie Bunker）是一个工人阶级的偏执狂，经常与家人就当今的重要问题发生争吵。
96.plotEn: Archie Bunker, a working class bigot, constantly squabbles with his family over the important issues of the day.

97.plot: 楼上：富有的贵族贝拉米家族。楼下：他们忠诚而活泼的仆人。近 30 年来，他们在伦敦豪华贝尔格莱维亚区伊顿广场 165 号共同居住了一栋时尚联排别墅，经历了社会变革、政治动荡、丑闻和第一次世界大战的恐怖。
97.plotEn: Upstairs: the wealthy, aristocratic Bellamys. Downstairs: their loyal and lively servants. For nearly 30 years, they share a fashionable townhouse at 165 Eaton Place in London’s posh Belgravia neighborhood, surviving social change, political upheaval, scandals, and the horrors of the First World War.

98.plot: 30 岁的单身玛丽·理查兹在一次浪漫分手后搬到明尼阿波利斯开始新的生活。在那里，她重新认识了菲利斯，菲利斯给她租了一个房间，并遇到了她楼上的邻居和新最好的朋友罗达。玛丽意外地在 WJM 电视台找到了一份副制片人的工作，在那里她和她脾气暴躁的老板卢一起工作。滑稽的新闻记者穆雷；还有经常无能的新闻主播特德。
98.plotEn: 30-year-old single Mary Richards moves to Minneapolis to start a new life after a romantic break-up. There she reacquaints with Phyllis who rents her a room, and meets her upstairs neighbor and new best friend Rhoda. Mary unexpectedly lands a job as associate producer at the TV station WJM, where she works alongside her bristly boss, Lou; the comical newswriter, Murray; and the newscast's often-incompetent anchor, Ted.

99.plot: 程侦探受国际刑警组织委托，摧毁柴巴帝国，这是一个总部位于东南亚的世界性犯罪组织。他发起了一项卧底行动来渗透该组织。
99.plotEn: Detective Cheng is commissioned by Interpol to destroy the Empire of Chaiba, a worldwide criminal organization based in Southeast Asia. He initiates an undercover operation to infiltrate the organization.

104.plot: 第4077机动部队外科医院陷于朝鲜战争中期。在他们所处环境的帮助下，他们不得不自娱自乐。医生、护士、管理人员和士兵喜欢恶作剧和复仇，他们经常想方设法让战时生活变得可以忍受。
104.plotEn: The 4077th Mobile Army Surgical Hospital is stuck in the middle of the Korean war. With little help from the circumstances they find themselves in, they are forced to make their own fun. Fond of practical jokes and revenge, the doctors, nurses, administrators, and soldiers often find ways of making wartime life bearable.

105.plot: 在弗吉尼亚州的蓝岭山脉，在大萧条时期，沃尔顿一家靠沃尔顿山上的锯木厂赚取微薄的收入。这个故事是通过约翰·博伊的眼睛讲述的，他想成为一名小说家，上了大学，最终实现了他的梦想。这部传奇讲述了一个家庭经历了大萧条和战争，经历了成长、学业、求爱、婚姻、就业、出生、衰老、疾病和死亡。
105.plotEn: The Waltons live their life in a rural Virginia community during the Great Depression and World War II.

107.plot: 这部历史迷你剧记录了伊丽莎白一世的统治，每一集都聚焦于处女女王漫长统治期间的一个戏剧性时期，包括她登上王位、她的各种婚姻阴谋、她与表妹苏格兰女王玛丽的问题，以及西班牙无敌舰队的入侵威胁。
107.plotEn: This historical mini-series documents the reign of Elizabeth I with each episode focusing on one dramatic period in the lengthy reign of the Virgin Queen, including her ascension to the throne, her various marital intrigues, her problems with her cousin Mary, Queen of Scots, and the threatened invasion of the Spanish Armada.

109.plot:
海斯斯托是一位新参议员，他与妻子艾琳和女儿诺玛一起来到华盛顿特区。他满怀乐观地来到这里，相信站在正义一边可以帮助他让事情变得更好……

这些角色最初出现在时长 2 小时的电视电影/试播片《清晰而现实的危险》（A Clear and Present Danger，1970）中。
109.plotEn:
Hays Stowe is a new senator who comes to Washington DC with his wife Erin and daughter Norma. He arrives full of optimism that being on the side of justice can help him change things for the better…

The characters originally appeared in the 2 hour TV-movie/pilot film A Clear and Present Danger (1970).

111.plot: 《威尔比医生》是一部美国医疗题材电视剧，于1969年9月23日至1976年7月29日在美国广播公司播出。该剧由罗伯特·杨饰演一位态度亲切的家庭医生，詹姆斯·布洛林则饰演常与其合作的年轻医师，制作人为大卫·维克托与大卫·J·奥康奈尔。其试播集《人道之事》曾于1969年3月26日作为"ABC每周电影"特别节目首播。
111.plotEn: Marcus Welby, M.D. is an American medical drama television program that aired on ABC from September 23, 1969, to July 29, 1976. It starred Robert Young as a family practitioner with a kind bedside manner and James Brolin as the younger doctor he often worked with, and was produced by David Victor and David J. O'Connell. The pilot, A Matter of Humanities, had aired as an ABC Movie of the Week on March 26, 1969.

112.plot:
《我的世界》和《欢迎来到它》是一部美国半小时电视情景喜剧，改编自詹姆斯·瑟伯的幽默和漫画。威廉·温多姆 (William Windom) 饰演约翰·门罗 (John Monroe)，一位类似瑟伯的作家和漫画家，为一家与《纽约客》非常相似的杂志《曼哈顿人》工作。梦露讽刺、爱幻想、脾气暴躁，对生活进行观察和评论，这让他相当明智的妻子艾伦和聪明、爱质疑的女儿莉迪亚感到困惑。梦露频繁的白日梦和幻想通常是基于瑟伯的材料。 《我的世界——欢迎来到它》是一本插图故事和散文集，作者也是詹姆斯·瑟伯。

该剧于 1969 年至 1970 年在 NBC 播出一季。该剧由梅尔·沙维尔森创作，他是试播集的编剧和导演，也是该剧的主要编剧之一。谢尔顿·伦纳德担任执行制片人。该剧的制片人丹尼·阿诺德 (Danny Arnold) 共同编剧或导演了多集剧集，甚至在“围旗集会”中饰演圣诞老人。
112.plotEn:
My World and Welcome to It is an American half-hour television sitcom based on the humor and cartoons of James Thurber. It starred William Windom as John Monroe, a Thurber-like writer and cartoonist who works for a magazine closely resembling The New Yorker called The Manhattanite. Wry, fanciful and curmudgeonly, Monroe observes and comments on life, to the bemusement of his rather sensible wife Ellen and intelligent, questioning daughter Lydia. Monroe's frequent daydreams and fantasies are usually based on Thurber material. My World — And Welcome To It is the name of a book of illustrated stories and essays, also by James Thurber.

The series ran one season on NBC 1969-1970. It was created by Mel Shavelson, who wrote and directed the pilot episode and was one of the show's principal writers. Sheldon Leonard was executive producer. The show's producer, Danny Arnold, co-wrote or directed numerous episodes, and even appeared as Santa Claus in "Rally Round the Flag."

113.plot: 虎胆妙算讲述「不可能小组」是个团队，他们专门负责解决最高难度的机密事件，不仅任务给的机密，而且成败自行负责，政府完全不承认有这个组织和任务，每次任务的给定，都是来自录音带中出现的声音，任务交代后，声音即被销毁。团队首领「龙头老大」负责企画，他深谙底下每个成员的能力，做出最精密万无一失的佈局，让每个人适任适份的扮演好自己的角色，而后按佈局完成任务。这很典型的是冷战时代会出现的影集。后改编为汤姆·克鲁斯主演的碟中谍系列电影。
113.plotEn:
Mission: Impossible is an American television series that was created and initially produced by Bruce Geller. It chronicles the missions of a team of secret government agents known as the Impossible Missions Force. In the first season, the team is led by Dan Briggs, played by Steven Hill; Jim Phelps, played by Peter Graves, takes charge for the remaining seasons. A hallmark of the series shows Briggs or Phelps receiving his instructions on a recording that then self-destructs, followed by the theme music composed by Lalo Schifrin.

The series aired on the CBS network from September 1966 to March 1973, then returned to television for two seasons on ABC, from 1988 to 1990, retaining only Graves in the cast. It later inspired a popular series of theatrical motion pictures starring Tom Cruise, beginning in 1996.

114.plot: 美国特工局最“精明”的特工名叫麦克斯维•精明，特工代号86。他是美国特工局的一名特工人员。根据他的领导——“头儿”的指示，麦克斯维与邪恶的混沌组织做着不懈的斗争。使用特种部队的“独特”武器，麦克斯维与他的搭档——99号特工一次次的击碎了混沌组织毁灭世界的阴谋，与特工局的全体同事一起立下了丰功伟绩。当然，他们同时也闹出了一串串的笑话。
114.plotEn: Maxwell Smart, a hilariously inept and maladroit secret agent for CONTROL, battles the nefarious—though equally incompetent—KAOS.

116.plot: 米奇、迈克、彼得和戴维是 20 世纪 60 年代中期洛杉矶的四位年轻人，他们是一支苦苦挣扎的乡村民谣摇滚乐队的成员，他们在与各种直接来自电视和电影中心演员的疯狂遭遇中寻找自己的重大突破，并且完全知道他们的存在是每周电视连续剧的一部分。
116.plotEn: Micky, Mike, Peter, and Davy are four young men in mid-1960s LA, members of a struggling country-folk-rock band looking for their big break amid madcap encounters with a variety of people straight out of TV and movie central casting, with full knowledge that their existence is part of a weekly television series.

117.plot: 金波医生的妻子在家中被人谋杀，虽然金波当晚撞见独臂凶手并与之搏斗，但是凶手终于逃走，金波本人却因种种不利证据被判定为谋杀罪。在押解前往监狱的途中，一名犯人试图逃脱造成狱车事故，金波在混乱中搭救了一名警员并趁夜色逃逸。赶到事故现场的联邦司法官山姆接手此案追捕金波，山姆为人精明强干，作风强硬，更重要的是，他怀有一颗探求真相的正义之心。山姆带队与金波展开了节奏紧凑的追捕与反追捕，金波在四面无援的困境中，依靠为爱妻报仇的意念坚持了下来，并将山姆引向此案的真相。原来某大制药厂为使一种失败的新药通过审查，动用了篡改医疗报告等不法手段，不肯合作的金波于是成为了他们暗杀的对象……
117.plotEn: Richard Kimble is falsely convicted of his wife's murder and given the death penalty. En route to death row, Kimble's train derails and crashes, allowing him to escape and begin a cross-country search for the real killer, a "one-armed man". At the same time, Dr. Kimble is hounded by the authorities, most notably dogged by Police Lieutenant Philip Gerard.

118.plot: 《迪克·范·戴克秀》以电视喜剧作家罗布·皮特里的工作和家庭生活为中心。故事情节通常围绕工作中的问题展开，罗布与其他编剧巴迪·索雷尔、莎莉·罗杰斯和制片人梅尔·库利陷入了各种喜剧困境。
118.plotEn: The Dick Van Dyke Show centers around the work and home life of television comedy writer Rob Petrie. The plots generally revolve around problems at work, where Rob got into various comedic jams with fellow writers Buddy Sorrell, Sally Rogers and producer Mel Cooley.

120.plot:
剧集聚焦纽约父子档辩护律师劳伦斯・普雷斯顿（Lawrence Preston）与肯尼斯・普雷斯顿（Kenneth Preston），聚焦当时极具争议的社会议题，包括安乐死、民权、政治暗杀、堕胎、黑名单、伪证与校园暴力等。每集以真实且具社会痛感的案件展开，法庭辩论犀利、伦理探讨深刻，是 60 年代美国律政剧的标杆之作。

与迈克尔・鲍威尔的关联

经权威资料核查，迈克尔・鲍威尔并未执导该剧任何一集。该剧主要导演包括巴兹・库里克（Buzz Kulik）、富兰克林・J・沙夫纳（Franklin J. Schaffner）、约翰・布拉姆（John Brahm）等。
120.plotEn: The Defenders is an American courtroom drama series . It starred E. G. Marshall and Robert Reed as father-and-son defense attorneys who specialized in legally complex cases, with defendants such as neo-Nazis, conscientious objectors, civil rights demonstrators, a schoolteacher fired for being an atheist, an author accused of pornography, and a physician charged in a mercy killing.

126.plot: 丹尼·托马斯是一名艺人，他试图平衡家庭生活和职业需求，并取得了令人捧腹的结果。
126.plotEn: Danny Thomas, an entertainer, tries to balance his home life with the needs of his career, with hilarious results.

127.plot:
《菲尔·西尔弗斯秀》原名为《你永远不会致富》，是一部情景喜剧，于 1955 年至 1959 年在哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 上播出，共 142 集，外加 1959 年的特别节目。该剧由菲尔·西尔弗斯 (Phil Silvers) 饰演美国陆军军士长欧内斯特·G·比尔科 (Ernest G. Bilko)。

该剧由纳特·希肯 (Nat Hiken) 创作并主要编剧，并连续三届获得艾美奖最佳喜剧系列奖。该剧在重播时有时被称为“比尔科中士”或简称为“比尔科”，并且在银幕上和观众中经常提到这些名字。该剧的成功使西尔弗斯从一位熟练的喜剧演员变成了明星，而编剧兼制片人希肯则从一位备受推崇的幕后喜剧作家变成了一位公众认可的创作者。
127.plotEn:
The Phil Silvers Show, originally titled You'll Never Get Rich, was a sitcom which ran on CBS from 1955 to 1959 for 142 episodes, plus a 1959 special. The series starred Phil Silvers as Master Sergeant Ernest G. Bilko of the United States Army.

The series was created and largely written by Nat Hiken, and won three consecutive Emmy Awards for Best Comedy Series. The show is sometimes titled Sergeant Bilko or simply Bilko in reruns, and is very often referred to by these names, both on-screen and by viewers. The show's success transformed Silvers from a journeyman comedian into a star, and writer-producer Hiken from a highly-regarded behind-the-scenes comedy writer into a publicly recognized creator.

128.plot: 特立独行的男孩们——布雷特、巴特、博和布伦特——是一群穿着考究的花花公子、赌徒，他们宁愿通过打牌赚钱，也不愿在实际工作中弄乱自己漂亮的衣服。狡猾而聪明，小牛队中没有一个人会做出大胆的举动，但当形势需要时，他们可以表现得很勇敢。然而，大多数情况下，他们靠自己的智慧和相当大的魅力生活。
128.plotEn: The Maverick boys - Bret, Bart, Beau and Brent - are a clan of well-dressed dandies, gamblers who'd much rather make their money playing cards than messing up their fine clothing with actual work. Sly and clever, none of the Mavericks are much for acts of derring do, but they can be courageous when the situation calls for it. Most often, however, they live by their wits and considerable charm.

129.plot: 《荒野大镖客》是一部由导演诺曼·麦克唐纳与编剧约翰·梅斯顿共同创作的美国西部题材广播剧及电视剧。故事发生在美国西部拓荒时期的堪萨斯州道奇城及其周边，核心人物是由威廉·康拉德（广播剧）与詹姆斯·阿尼斯（电视剧）分别饰演的执法官马特·狄龙。
129.plotEn: Gunsmoke is an American radio and television Western drama series created by director Norman MacDonnell and writer John Meston. The stories take place in and around Dodge City, Kansas, during the settlement of the American West. The central character is lawman Marshal Matt Dillon, played by William Conrad on radio and James Arness on television.

130.plot: 讲述了一位热心的洛杉矶警探乔·星期五警官和他的搭档的案件。该剧的名字来源于警察术语“dragnet”，意思是逮捕罪犯或嫌疑人的协调措施系统。
130.plotEn: Follows the cases of a dedicated Los Angeles police detective, Sergeant Joe Friday, and his partners. The show takes its name from the police term "dragnet", meaning a system of coordinated measures for apprehending criminals or suspects.

131.plot: 一部美国广播电视选集系列剧，由从 CBC 加盟 CBS 的加拿大导演弗莱彻·马克尔 (Fletcher Markle) 于 1947 年创作。 Studio One 由西屋电气出品，是最早的选集电视节目之一。这些剧集通常是对过去几年电影的删节重拍，许多未来的知名电视和电影演员都出现在制作中。
131.plotEn: An American radio–television anthology series, created in 1947 by Canadian director Fletcher Markle, who came to CBS from the CBC. Studio One, presented by Westinghouse, was one of the first of the anthology TV programs. The episodes were often abridged remakes of movies from years gone by and many future well-known television and movie actors appeared in the productions.

132.plot: 如果古巴乐队指挥瑞奇·里卡多的妻子露西只是一名家庭主妇，他会很高兴。相反，她不断地尝试在他工作的 Tropicana 表演，并让他们与房东 Fred 和 Ethel Mertz（碰巧也是他们最好的朋友）合住的公寓楼里的生活变得滑稽疯狂。
132.plotEn: Cuban Bandleader Ricky Ricardo would be happy if his wife Lucy would just be a housewife. Instead she tries constantly to perform at the Tropicana where he works, and make life comically frantic in the apartment building they share with landlords Fred and Ethel Mertz, who also happen to be their best friends.
